email.body1:
Daniel, saw Sonatype's 2026 report land with open-source malware up 75 percent to over 1.2 million packages, exactly the urgency that opens enterprise doors across EMEA.

That demand puts more accounts worth reaching than your reps can personally cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Sonatype off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit your EMEA number
email.body2:
Daniel, quick follow-up for Sonatype.

A report that strong drives inbound and named accounts faster than EMEA headcount can absorb, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number across the region. The gap shows up late, then the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Sonatype EMEA needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daniel, last bit of proof for Sonatype.

Memgraph, also a technical software company, had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatype's EMEA reply rate likely compares to peer security teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Daniel, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling EMEA coverage without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Report season is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an EMEA enterprise-security motion? I will tailor it to Sonatype either way.
